phase: post-search refinement, not part of the U/E discovery arms
selection: Advance the expert arm's archival claim instrument for a falsifying construction; withhold flagship status because certain-answer and query-cleaning prior art already cover its core.
root_followup_searches: "historical" "data rescue" transcription uncertainty scientific analysis paper
original_purpose: Answer an explicitly specified linear contrast of archived numerical measurements, preserving all declared transcription, calibration and source-error uncertainty.
binding_restriction: A conventional transcribe-every-cell workflow postpones analysis until a single dataset is fixed; naive per-cell intervals discard shared calibration dependence.
proposed_change: Compute the exact minimum and maximum of the unchanged query over an explicitly bounded set of admissible records and emit extremal witnesses. Permit a claim only if every admitted world supports it.
prior_art_gate: Must document a substantive advance beyond certain-answer databases, query-guided cleaning, robust optimization and existing archive transcription tools. Efficient implementation or renaming alone fails. Current status: UNPROVEN.
scope: Research-authored finite possible-world cases, not source-verified historical data or a climate conclusion.

frozen_design.source_model: independent finite glyph alternatives + shared group calibration choices + up to k bounded signed row errors
frozen_design.decision: TRUE if lower>threshold; FALSE if upper<=threshold; otherwise UNRESOLVED
frozen_design.primary_acceptance: Exact lower/upper and valid extremal witnesses equal independent enumeration on every valid case; correctly refuse malformed and unsupported inputs.
frozen_design.failure_rule: Retain every error; version corrections separately; do not tune primary policy on confirmation outcomes.
frozen_design.freeze_order: Implement core, hash it, then generate hidden fresh cases from fixed seeds and execute independent comparison.

novelty_falsifiers: Existing strong methods provide the same functional contract with no demonstrated additional capability or effort advantage.
Observed gain depends on dropping correlated uncertainty, assuming unsupported source calibration, or changing the query.
Usefulness disappears when the cost of constructing/validating the admissible set is included.
commercial: Conditional same-offering model only, with endogenous participation, costs, failure, refunds, bad debt, financing and no actual revenue.
evidence_boundaries: No live ENS or on-chain actions
No new claim of beyond-human foresight
